title: interact
summary: The player-facing core of Benilla's 'what am I pointing at' foundation exists in MSUI's own shape: per-frame hover pick (PickUnit - vplate rects first, then ray vs unit cylinders with world-collision occlusion test), clean world click/right-click routing (left selects/clears, right routes by classification: lootable corpse -> loot, gossip NPC -> gossip, player -> popup, hostile -> attack), and ground picking for AoE targeting (collision raycast + terrain-heightfield bisect). Benilla's inspector overlay and cast journal are dev instruments; MSUI achieves that role through its own Program.DevTools.* partials and EmitInterface evidence stream.

openItems.text: GameObjects and doodads are not mouse-pickable: PickUnit iterates units only, so right-click-to-use a chest/vein/mailbox in the world never happens from the cursor (UseGameObject is reachable only via selection-driven/dev paths)
